Bank of Baroda's Q4FY26/FY26 investor presentation showed FY26 net profit of ₹20,021 Cr (up 2.2%) and Q4FY26 net profit of ₹5,616 Cr; with GNPA at 1.89%.
2026-05-08: Bank of Baroda's board approved raising up to ₹6,000 Cr via Additional Tier 1 and/or Tier II bonds in tranches up to 31.03.2027, subject to statutory/regulatory approvals.
Bank of Baroda shared Q4 FY2025-26 financial results media and analyst meet recordings via its website on 08.05.2026.
Bank of Baroda reported Q4FY26 net profit of ₹5,616 Cr, up 11.2% YoY, and upsized FY27 loan growth guidance to 12-14%.
Bank of Baroda corrected its Annual Report for FY2025-26, fixing the Dividend Payout Ratio (21.96% vs. 22.05%) and a typographical error in provisions (₹(21.05) vs. ₹21.05) on 31-Mar-2026.
Bank of Baroda schedules a Media Meet on 30th October 2026 at 5:00 PM via Zoom and an Analyst Meet on 30th October 2026 at 6:00 PM.
Bank of Baroda clarified to the exchanges that it has not been served with any suit or interim applications by Dr. BR Shetty in the Bombay High Court.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹37,020.59 Cr (+11.1% YoY), net profit ₹6,737.28 Cr (+31.2% YoY).
Bank of Baroda reported consolidated net profit of ₹6,737 Cr for Q2FY27, up 31.2% YoY.
Bank of Baroda provided a link to the audio and video recording of the analyst meet held on 30.10.2026 for Q2 FY2026-27 financial results.
